item.title: Design a Fair Volunteer Rotation
item.prompt_text: People often volunteer to welcome visitors but rarely choose the work of setting up chairs and checking signs before opening. Returning volunteers say the same people get the less visible jobs. Propose a rotation that lets newcomers learn, preserves reliable opening, and gives experienced volunteers a fair way to change roles.
item.audience: organisers of a community open day
item.target_grammar: Conditionals, concessive phrasing and distinctions between a rule and an exception.
item.target_structure: Describe the problem without blame, outline a rotation, then show how the exception and review would work.

checklist.point: Describe why the usual allocation feels uneven.
Propose a rotation with a way for newcomers to learn.
Explain how people could ask for a change.
Protect opening reliability with a concrete check.
